<!-- pr-reviewer: 1c06a3e1e37d53b7a48d3e27708eb8b2b0190f27 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The new guards refuse a G86 dwell by name on all five selected posts. The command checks reject a dwell outside the stated range. The changes use the existing command and undo paths.

I reviewed this safety-tier change locally after a trial merge with upstream/main at e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8. The merge had no conflicts. I used the current upstream AGENTS.md. I did not use a GitHub runner.

Results:
- The app `bore_cycle` test target does not compile. No app bore tests ran.
- The post `bore_cycle` suite has 5 passed tests and 2 failed tests.
- The existing `ream_cycle` suites pass: 3 app tests and 5 post tests.
- Clippy passes with `-D warnings` for both libraries and for all post targets.
- The combined app/post all-target Clippy check fails in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106`. That unchanged upstream fixture has an obsolete `CuttingRow` initializer. This is a separate upstream fault.
- I read all six new NC golden files line by line. No existing golden file changes.
- Mutation 1: I disabled the Fanuc G86 dwell guard. The refusal test failed. I restored the guard, and the test passed.
- Mutation 2: I disabled the Haas G86 dwell guard. The refusal test failed. I restored the guard, and the test passed.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/bore_cycle.rs:50`: Add `break_through: None` to the `OpParams::Drill` fixture. Current main requires this field. Then run all three app bore tests. The compiler reports:
   ```text
   error[E0063]: missing field `break_through` in initializer of `OpParams`
   ```
2. `crates/post/tests/bore_cycle.rs:183`: Change the expanded-bore test to match the safety refusal on current main. Heidenhain, TinyG and Carvera now refuse a bore because they cannot stop the spindle before the rapid retract. The test fails at its first Heidenhain call. Check the named refusal and the absence of cutting output. Remove the unsafe Heidenhain golden expectation from `GOLDEN`. Update the body and decision record to describe the refusal. Do not restore the unsafe expansion. The diagnostic is:
   ```text
   operation Bore: bore (G86) requires a spindle stop before rapid retract - expanded boring is not supported by this post; refused, not posted
   ```
3. `crates/post/tests/golden/bore/fanuc.nc:12`: Update the new NC goldens against current main, after item 2. The byte comparison fails because main now writes decimal points on coordinate words. For example, the golden has `G00 Z10`, but the post writes `G00 Z10.`. Check each regenerated line and run the complete post bore suite.

The new post refusal test detects both tested guard removals. The app validation tests still need execution after the fixture fix. No UI screenshot requirement applies. No real control ran this output.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
